about.title: About
about.p1: ravazque.info shows statistics for 42 Madrid students, built on the 42 API. It is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by 42. Sign in with your 42 account and it reads your own data from the 42 API: logged-in time and seats, projects and attempts, evaluations received and given, feedback, correction points, skills and events.
about.p2: It is only for students whose main campus is 42 Madrid and who have started the 42cursus: students, transcenders and alumni. Staff, pisciners and blackholed or frozen accounts cannot use it.
about.p3: The 42 API limits how many requests an application can make, so your data can be refreshed once an hour. The first load takes about a minute.
about.p4: Some figures are inferences and the page says so: where you sat during an evaluation comes from your login sessions, and the XP of each project is a calculation.

policy.purpose.title: Purpose
policy.purpose.body: To show you your own 42 history: logged time and seats, projects and attempts, exams, pace, evaluations given and received, the people you crossed paths with, your promo and the coalitions.
Data is never sold, never used for advertising or profiling, no decisions about you are made with it, and there are no usage analytics.
policy.from_api.title: Data obtained from the 42 API
policy.from_api.list: About you: login, name, photo, campus and coalition; cursus, level, skills, projects, marks, exams, Common Core and blackhole dates, achievements, titles and quests; login sessions and the computers you used; events; evaluations given and received with their dates, marks, flags, comments and your own feedback; correction points and wallet. The intra's own daily logtime, the 42 groups on your profile, and the points you have given your coalition (amount, kind and date).

About other students: their login, name and rank group, as they appear in your own evaluations and teams, and, for your evaluations of the last 60 days only, the computer the other side (your corrector, or the students you evaluated) was logged in at during that evaluation. It is worked out from their login sessions of that day, which are read and dropped at once: only the seat is kept, inside your report. Their photos are never loaded. Promo and coalition figures are counts without names.
Only data the intra already shows to members of the 42 Network is used.
policy.generated.title: Data generated by the site
policy.generated.list: Session: a random id in the __Host-session cookie; in the server's memory, your login, name, photo link, coalition colour and a request token.
Your analysed report: the original is kept in your browser (IndexedDB). The server keeps a signed copy in memory to draw your pages, for one hour after its last use; it is never written to disk.
Record of your acceptance of this policy: a keyed hash of your 42 id, the accepted version and the date. It is the only thing the server writes to disk.
Hourly refresh limit: a keyed hash of your 42 id, in memory, for at most 60 minutes.
Sign-in attempts: a keyed hash of your IP address, in memory, for 10 minutes, to prevent sign-in abuse.
policy.basis.title: Legal basis
policy.basis.list: Consent (Art. 6.1.a GDPR) for your own data and the data the site generates: you give it by ticking the box and signing in, and it is recorded.

Legitimate interest (Art. 6.1.f GDPR) for showing the login, name and rank group of the students in your own evaluations and teams, and where the other side of your recent evaluations sat, which the intra already shows to the 42 Network. They can object at any time (see Exclusion).
policy.terms.title: Terms of use
policy.terms.list: The data comes from the 42 Network and must stay within it: do not share, publish or redistribute other students' data.
Bulk extraction, automated access and attempts to bypass access controls or limits are forbidden.
Your session is personal: do not share it.
Misuse may lead to loss of access.
The service is provided as is. Data can be up to an hour behind: the intra is always the official source.
policy.liability.title: Disclaimer and limitation of liability
policy.liability.body: The site is a free, personal and independent project, provided "as is" and "as available", with no warranty of any kind, express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose, accuracy or availability. It may be unavailable, change or stop at any time, and its figures may be incomplete, delayed, estimated or wrong; the 42 intranet is always the authoritative source.

To the fullest extent permitted by law, {controller} shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental or consequential loss or damage arising from the use of, or inability to use, the site, or from reliance on anything it shows. Nothing in this policy excludes or limits liability that cannot lawfully be excluded, such as for intent or gross negligence, nor affects your mandatory rights under data-protection or consumer law.

You are solely responsible for how you use the data shown and for complying with 42's own terms. Access and the service may be restricted, suspended or withdrawn at any time, in particular in case of misuse.

"42", "42 Network" and related names and logos belong to their respective owners; this project is not affiliated with, authorised or endorsed by them and claims no rights over them. The site's own source code is released under the AGPL-3.0 licence.
policy.retention.title: Retention
policy.retention.list: Session: 7 days, renewed while you use it; it also ends when the server restarts.
Report: in your browser until you sign out or delete your data; the server's copy, one hour after its last use or at once with "Delete my data".
Acceptance record: 2 years after your last sign-in.
Refresh limit: 60 minutes. Sign-in attempts: 10 minutes.
Language cookie: 1 year. Theme and accent: in your browser until you clear them.
policy.security.title: Security
policy.security.list: Encrypted connection only (HTTPS with HSTS) and a strict content security policy.
Your 42 access token is used once to identify you and never stored; tokens never reach the browser.
HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite session cookie; every action that changes something carries a request token.
No database: the server keeps sessions and report copies in memory only. A report your browser hands back is accepted only with the server's own signature for your account.
No third-party cookies, trackers or scripts.
In case of a security breach, the people affected and, where required, the authority will be notified.
policy.third.title: Third parties
policy.third.body: Data is never sold or shared for any other purpose. The site is reached through Cloudflare (Cloudflare, Inc.), which carries the encrypted connection between your browser and the server: like any such network, it handles your IP address and the requests in transit, possibly outside the EU, under its own privacy policy (cloudflare.com/privacypolicy). The server only talks to the 42 API (api.intra.42.fr) and its image CDN (cdn.intra.42.fr); your browser contacts no other service through this site.
policy.rights.title: Your rights
policy.rights.list: Access: see which of your data is stored (all of it is on your dashboard and in your browser).
Rectification: data comes from the intra, so it is corrected there.
Erasure: "Delete my data" removes the server's copy and clears this site's storage in your browser; signing out removes the report from your browser. To delete the source data, contact 42.
Restriction of and objection to processing, and portability of your data.
Withdraw your consent at any time by deleting your data and signing out; this does not affect earlier processing.
policy.rights.body: Requests are answered within one month. You can also lodge a complaint with the Spanish data protection authority (AEPD, www.aepd.es).
policy.exclusion.title: Exclusion
policy.exclusion.body: If you appear in someone else's report and want to be excluded, write to {email} with your login: you will be shown as "Hidden" in every report, with no name, photo or seat.

Your circle of students who evaluate each other, connections grouped by where they are today, and your teammates with the projects you shared.

about.why: Mainly to learn: to work with the 42 API from end to end, and to give 42 Madrid students what the intra keeps scattered or does not show at all. How many hours you have really spent on campus and where you sat, whom you evaluated and who evaluated you, how long each evaluation took, how your projects and retries add up over time. All of it about you, in one place.

about.feature_2: The cluster plan with the computers you used most, and every login session
about.feature_3: Evaluations given and received over time, with marks, flags, duration and how far ahead they were booked

about.feature_6: Every project and attempt on one timeline, with retries, marks, moulinette results and correctors
about.feature_7: Exams with every try, and the days each project took to validate
about.feature_8: XP by technical domain (the intra's RNCP tags) and a portfolio export as CSV
about.feature_9: Your circle of students who evaluate each other, connections by rank, and your teammates
about.feature_10: Coalition points by source, your latest contributions and why, and the 50 h / 80 h logtime bonus with a forecast
about.feature_11: Your place in your promo by level, and the standings of the Madrid coalitions
about.feature_12: Level, pace, skills, wallet, evaluation points, your blackhole or, in the Outer Core, an estimate of when you become alumni
about.feature_13: Light and dark mode, English and Spanish, in the 42 colour or your coalition's
about.pages: HTML rendered on the server with Jinja and htmx; the charts are drawn on the server as SVG and HTML, and a little JavaScript adds tooltips and sorting.
about.backend: Python (FastAPI), sign-in with 42 OAuth2, and batched, paginated requests to the 42 API.
about.infra: Docker Compose and Caddy (reverse proxy and TLS). No database: the server keeps your report in memory for an hour, and the original lives in your browser.
about.beta: This project is in beta and changes often. If you find a bug or have an idea, open an issue or write to ravazque on Slack.

bonus.title: Logtime bonus
bonus.lede: At every logout the intra adds up your last seven rolling days of connection (sessions on two computers count once): 50 h gives +500 to your coalition and 80 h +1000, each at most once every seven days since it was last given. Hours older than seven days leave the window as time passes. This is our reading of the rule, which 42 does not publish: checked on 28 Oct 2026 against the real awards of 11 students over 12 days, every award came at the logout the rule names, to the minute; in 2 of 11 cases the rule expected an award that did not come.
